title: US stocks: US market slips as rising Treasury yields offset AI-driven tech gains - The Economic Times
text:
US stock indices fell as increasing government bond yields weakened investor sentiment across the market. The Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500, and Nasdaq Composite all reported losses during the trading session. Chipmakers limited broader declines, recovering ground after prior selloffs, despite mixed performance among megacap stocks. US job openings and consumer confidence figures missed analysts' expectations, adding to market uncertainty.
